name: T-Mobile Visa

fx_fee.notes: Capital One states that it doesn't charge foreign transaction fees on any of its U.S.-issued credit cards.

base_rate.description: 2% back in T-Mobile Rewards on all other net purchases.

categories.label: Phones, devices and accessories bought at T-Mobile.com, the T-Life app, T-Mobile stores and authorized retailers

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards can be used toward a new phone, device or the T-Mobile bill and don't expire for the life of the account.

benefits.title: T-Mobile AutoPay discount
benefits.description: $5 off per line per month when the card is used for T-Mobile AutoPay (eligible plans only, up to 8 lines).

notes: Available only to T-Mobile customers. The product page footnotes describe 'T-Mobile Visa Signature cardholders' and link to the Visa Signature benefits, so network_tier is signature. APR is in the rates and disclosures overlay and is not captured.
